name: Pufferfish

items.name: Toxic Body
items.text: Anyone who hits a pufferfish with a melee unarmed attack or a non-reach melee weapon must succeed at a DC 13 Reflex save save or be pierced by a spine, taking 1 piercing damage and being exposed to pufferfish venom.

items.name: Inflating Rush
items.text: The pufferfish Swims up to its Speed and then inflates. Each creature within 5-foot emanation of its space at the end of its movement must succeed at a DC 13 Reflex save save or take 1 piercing damage and be exposed to pufferfish venom.

items.name: Pufferfish Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 16 Fortitude save

---

Maximum Duration 24 hours

Stage 1 1d4 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d4 poison damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 3 1d4 poison damage and Paralyzed (1 round)

Stage 4 1d4 poison damage and paralyzed for 2d10 hours (1 round)

text:
The pufferfish defends itself by filling its flexible body with air or water to extend a number of spikes that otherwise lie flat against its skin. While normally quite slow and deliberate, the pufferfish can contort its body to gain a sudden burst of speed that can catch predators off guard.

---

Swimming in vast shoals through open ocean underneath the sparkling sun, lurking deep in the muddy beds of rivers, or schooling in pristine lakes, fish are found nearly anywhere there is water.
